capabilities: Export a whole .md file or selected Markdown text as styled images
Write generated image files into a chosen vault folder
Insert Obsidian image links back into the source note
Remember template, brand text, size, format, and quality settings
extras: Desktop-only: it uses local Node.js modules at runtime. The converter backend must be set up separately (default is a local HTTP service); no API key is required. Privacy section explains that Markdown content is sent only to the configured backend.
problem: Obsidian can export notes in some formats but has no built-in way to turn a note or selected text into styled shareable images.

relations.evidence: the plugin can also call a local 38html project module directly

requires.name: local converter backend (local HTTP service or local 38html project module)

summary: Markdown-to-image exporter that renders whole files or editor selections as styled, paginated images via a local converter backend.
